<p class="eyebrow">Background</p>

<h2>Technical depth. Clinical context. Business perspective.</h2>

I work in data analytics at the **Oregon Primary Care Association (OPCA)**, where I help turn healthcare data into reporting systems and analytical products for community health centers. Previously, I worked as a Technical Support Engineer at Salesforce, troubleshooting custom code and integrations for commercial and government clients.

My path into healthcare analytics spans technology, business, and clinical practice. I hold a B.S. in Computer Science and an MBA, and my earlier experience in paramedicine gives me firsthand context for the clinical workflows behind healthcare data.
:::
